title: Command injection through non-obvious sources: filenames, URLs, archive members, delegates
index_line: T-0005 · EXEC · the source is the trick (filename/config/delegate), metachars OR argv flags · corroborated
invariant_violated: The app treats a value as inert data; a subprocess — or the shell it invokes — treats it as syntax, or as a flag.

mechanism.does: attacker-controlled value enters via a non-obvious source: uploaded filename, remote URL, archive member name, config/manifest field, delegate placeholder
value spliced into a command string (shell family) or an argv array (no-shell family)
shell parses metachars, or the target tool parses the value as an option/argv[0]
escaping defeated (missing shellescape, delegate templates that never quote) or flags inject directly

source.file.name.value: uploaded/processed file's name — the highest-yield non-obvious source

sink.exec.noshell.value: argv subprocess — argument injection via leading '-' flags (git --upload-pack, curl -K, ssh -o)

guard.escaping.value: shellescape/shlex.quote/array-argv allowlist — what must be absent or defeated

delegate.tool.value: external tool delegate: ImageMagick delegates.xml (%f/%u), ESLint processors, git hooks, build scripts

preconditions.expr: subprocess-capable runtime with a call site
attacker value reaches the call site
varies — upload/processing features usually authenticated user

success: captured marker output from the spawned command (id/whoami/echo)
file created by the spawned command at a known path
error message echoes the expanded command string
failure_like: argv passed without shell and no flag-shaped control — metachars print literally
false_positive: delegate/config files the attacker cannot reach

hazards: no-shell runtimes (java/dotnet/go/rust, argv forms) shift the bug class to argument injection — pick the family by the call, not by habit
tool delegates parse their own flags — read the tool's option table before crafting
non_transfers: strict argv allowlists with no option-shaped control

provenance.author: 0security playbook corpus
provenance.corroborates: method detail + verified wins (ImageMagick delegates, ESLint processor filenames)
